title: Origami self-powered near-sensor computing system using 2D materials for deformation monitoring
summary: An origami-inspired triboelectric device drives two-dimensional vermiculite memory to combine self-powered structural deformation sensing, local computing, and storage.
summary_zh: 折纸式摩擦电器件直接驱动二维蛭石忆阻器，将结构形变感知、近传感计算和存储集成为自供能系统。

title: TacTID: High-Performance Visuo-Tactile Sensor-Based Terrain Identification for Legged Robots
summary: A visuo-tactile foot sensor estimates terrain friction and effective stiffness from three-dimensional pressure information for real-time terrain identification with a quadruped robot.
summary_zh: 视触觉足端传感器利用三维压力分布估计地形摩擦与等效刚度，并在四足机器人上验证实时地形识别。

title: A Broad Range Triboelectric Stiffness Sensor for Variable Inclusions Recognition
summary: A self-powered triboelectric stiffness sensor decouples force and displacement signals and applies signal processing and SVM classification to recognize inclusions in soft objects.
summary_zh: 自供能摩擦电刚度传感器解耦力与位移信息，并结合信号处理及支持向量机识别软物体中的包埋异物。
